senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; רמם to move; cmp. רחש a. deriv.) worm, esp. the worm in man’s grave.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 18b:5">Ber. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>קשׁה ר׳ למת וכ׳</he> the worm is as painful to the dead body as a needle in sound flesh.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 83b:11">B. Mets. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>אין ר׳ ותולעה וכ׳</he> no worm of any kind shall have power over you.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:4">Ab. IV, 4</cite> <he>תקות אנוש ר׳</he> the prospects of man are worms.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:10:2">Koh. R. to V, 10</cite> <he>הרי הוא לר׳ ותולעה</he> he is (food) for worms; a. fr.—Pesik. Vayhi, p. 93ᵇ (in Chald. dict.) <he>דהדין גופא אזל לר׳</he> that this (my) body must go to the worms; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:2:1">Koh. R. to XI, 2</cite> <he>לאדמה</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:2:1">ib.</cite> <he>ברם ר׳ לית וכ׳</he> but worms shall have no power over me except &c.
